Name: CS_SSAO_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Screen-space ambient occlusion settings for each level of the SSAO option. Loaded from the system params, not regulation.bin. The whole param is ignored if its data version is not 2.

Fields.Name: SSAO Enabled
Fields.Description: Turns SSAO on for this level.

Fields.Name: Reprojection Mode
Fields.Description: Temporal reprojection of SSAO: 0 follows the scene's setting, 1 forces it off, 2 forces it on.

Fields.Name: Bilateral Upscale Mode
Fields.Description: Bilateral upscale of SSAO: 0 follows the scene's setting, 1 forces it off, 2 forces it on.

Fields.Name: Use Normals Mode
Fields.Description: Use of surface normals by SSAO: 0 follows the scene's setting, 1 forces it off, 2 forces it on.
